The toys are back in Disney and Pixar’s “Toy Story 5,” and this time around it’s Toy meets Tech. 

With Woody helping abandoned toys find owners, Jessie is now the leader of Bonnie's room, with Buzz Lightyear as her second-in-command. But the gang’s jobs get exponentially harder when they go head to head with this all-new threat to playtime…a frog-like tablet named Lilypad.
tmdb_overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

synopsis:
500 MILES is a poetic, life-affirming road movie and celebration of the human spirit that follows a broken family who are forced to come together when two young brothers run away from home.

While their fighting parents (Clare Dunne & Michael Socha) tear their hair out with worry, runaways Finn (Roman Griffin Davis) and his live-wire younger brother Charlie (Dexter Sol Ansell) embark on an epic adventure from Yorkshire, over land and sea, to the Wild West coast of Ireland. With the free-spirited busker Cate (Maisie Williams) helping the young boys along the way, their destination is Dingle, County Kerry, and their estranged, beloved Grandfather (BAFTA-award winner Bill Nighy), who their parents haven’t spoken to since the fateful events of the previous summer.
tmdb_overview: A broken family is forced to come together when 16-year-old Finn and his livewire younger brother Charlie run away from trouble at home in England to reach their estranged grandfather on Ireland’s stunning and wild west coast.

synopsis: Niki (Leo Woodall) is a gifted young piano tuner whose heightened sense of hearing draws the attention of criminals, who see his talents as useful for opening safes as for tuning Steinways. With his once-promising musical career over, he now works across New York under the guidance of his mentor Harry Horowitz (Academy Award-winner Dustin Hoffman), encountering a range of characters, including composition student Ruthie (Havana Rose Liu), with whom he forges an unexpected connection. Niki’s safecracking work threatens his budding romance with Ruthie and pulls him into increasingly dangerous territory.
tmdb_overview: A talented piano tuner's life is turned upside down when he discovers that his meticulous skills for tuning pianos can equally be applied to cracking safes.

synopsis:

synopsis:
Michael is the cinematic portrayal of the life and legacy of one of the most influential artists the world has ever known.

The film tells the story of Michael Jackson’s life beyond the music, tracing his journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fuelled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world.

synopsis:
As Miranda Priestly (Meryl Streep) nears retirement, she reunites with Andy Sachs (Anne Hathaway) to face off against Emily Charlton (Emily Blunt), her former assistant turned rival, as they compete for advertising revenue amidst declining print media.

Twenty years after making their iconic turns as Miranda, Andy, Emily and Nigel- Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt and Stanley Tucci return to the fashionable streets of New York City and the sleek offices of Runway Magazine in 20th Century Studios’ “The Devil Wears Prada 2,” the eagerly awaited sequel to the 2006 phenomenon that defined a generation.

The Devil Wears Prada 2 reunites the original main cast of Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt, and Stanley Tucci with director David Frankel and writer Aline Brosh McKenna. It also introduces an all-new runway of characters including Kenneth Branagh, Simone Ashley, Justin Theroux, Lucy Lui and more. The film also features an original song ""Runway"" performed by Lady Gaga and Doechii.
tmdb_overview: Miranda Priestly navigates her career amid the decline of traditional magazine publishing. She faces off against Emily Charlton, her one-time assistant, now a high-powered executive for a luxury group, with advertising dollars that Priestly desperately needs.

synopsis: Evil Dead Burn unleashes the franchise’s most savage and terrifying ride to date, blazing onto big screens with an all-new chapter of carnage and demonic mayhem. After serving fifteen years in prison, bank robber Anker (Nikolaj Lie Kaas) is determined to recover the stolen money his brother Manfred (Mads Mikkelsen) buried years earlier. There's just one problem: Manfred, caught in an identity crisis and convinced he is John Lennon, can no longer remember where it is hidden. The brothers set off on an increasingly chaotic hunt for the missing fortune, digging up old family secrets on the way.

Beyond screens every Monday matinee and Tuesday evening, showcasing independent films that might not be on your radar (yet!) but are well worth experiencing on the big screen.

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

synopsis:
As Miranda Priestly (Meryl Streep) nears retirement, she reunites with Andy Sachs (Anne Hathaway) to face off against Emily Charlton (Emily Blunt), her former assistant turned rival, as they compete for advertising revenue amidst declining print media.

Twenty years after making their iconic turns as Miranda, Andy, Emily and Nigel- Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt and Stanley Tucci return to the fashionable streets of New York City and the sleek offices of Runway Magazine in 20th Century Studios’ “The Devil Wears Prada 2,” the eagerly awaited sequel to the 2006 phenomenon that defined a generation.

The Devil Wears Prada 2 reunites the original main cast of Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt, and Stanley Tucci with director David Frankel and writer Aline Brosh McKenna. It also introduces an all-new runway of characters including Kenneth Branagh, Simone Ashley, Justin Theroux, Lucy Lui and more. The film also features an original song ""Runway"" performed by Lady Gaga and Doechii.
tmdb_overview: Miranda Priestly navigates her career amid the decline of traditional magazine publishing. She faces off against Emily Charlton, her one-time assistant, now a high-powered executive for a luxury group, with advertising dollars that Priestly desperately needs.

With Woody helping abandoned toys find owners, Jessie is now the leader of Bonnie's room, with Buzz Lightyear as her second-in-command. But the gang’s jobs get exponentially harder when they go head to head with this all-new threat to playtime…a frog-like tablet named Lilypad.

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

synopsis:
500 MILES is a poetic, life-affirming road movie and celebration of the human spirit that follows a broken family who are forced to come together when two young brothers run away from home.

While their fighting parents (Clare Dunne & Michael Socha) tear their hair out with worry, runaways Finn (Roman Griffin Davis) and his live-wire younger brother Charlie (Dexter Sol Ansell) embark on an epic adventure from Yorkshire, over land and sea, to the Wild West coast of Ireland. With the free-spirited busker Cate (Maisie Williams) helping the young boys along the way, their destination is Dingle, County Kerry, and their estranged, beloved Grandfather (BAFTA-award winner Bill Nighy), who their parents haven’t spoken to since the fateful events of the previous summer.
tmdb_overview: A broken family is forced to come together when 16-year-old Finn and his livewire younger brother Charlie run away from trouble at home in England to reach their estranged grandfather on Ireland’s stunning and wild west coast.

synopsis:
Live-action adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film 'Moana'.

An adventurous teenager sails out on a daring mission to save her people. During her journey, Moana meets the once-mighty demigod Maui, who guides her in her quest to become a master way-finder. Together they sail across the open ocean on an action-packed voyage, encountering enormous monsters and impossible odds. Along the way, Moana fulfills the ancient quest of her ancestors and discovers the one thing she always sought: her own identity.
tmdb_overview: Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with the infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

synopsis:
As Miranda Priestly (Meryl Streep) nears retirement, she reunites with Andy Sachs (Anne Hathaway) to face off against Emily Charlton (Emily Blunt), her former assistant turned rival, as they compete for advertising revenue amidst declining print media.

Twenty years after making their iconic turns as Miranda, Andy, Emily and Nigel- Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt and Stanley Tucci return to the fashionable streets of New York City and the sleek offices of Runway Magazine in 20th Century Studios’ “The Devil Wears Prada 2,” the eagerly awaited sequel to the 2006 phenomenon that defined a generation.

The Devil Wears Prada 2 reunites the original main cast of Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt, and Stanley Tucci with director David Frankel and writer Aline Brosh McKenna. It also introduces an all-new runway of characters including Kenneth Branagh, Simone Ashley, Justin Theroux, Lucy Lui and more. The film also features an original song ""Runway"" performed by Lady Gaga and Doechii.
tmdb_overview: Miranda Priestly navigates her career amid the decline of traditional magazine publishing. She faces off against Emily Charlton, her one-time assistant, now a high-powered executive for a luxury group, with advertising dollars that Priestly desperately needs.

synopsis:
Dom Cobb is a skilled thief, the absolute best in the dangerous art of extraction, stealing valuable secrets from deep within the subconscious during the dream state when the mind is at its most vulnerable. Cobb's rare ability has made him a coveted player in this treacherous new world of corporate espionage, but it has also made him an international fugitive and cost him everything he has ever loved. Now, Cobb is being offered a chance at redemption. One last job could give him his life back, but only if he can accomplish the impossible -- inception.

Screening on Sundays and Wednesdays as part of our Nolan Throwback Season, where we revisit classics. Each ticket to these showtimes includes complimentary popcorn and a drink.
tmdb_overview: Cobb, a skilled thief who commits corporate espionage by infiltrating the subconscious of his targets is offered a chance to regain his old life as payment for a task considered to be impossible: "inception", the implantation of another person's idea into a target's subconscious.

synopsis: Evil Dead Burn unleashes the franchise’s most savage and terrifying ride to date, blazing onto big screens with an all-new chapter of carnage and demonic mayhem. synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

synopsis:
The toys are back in Disney and Pixar’s “Toy Story 5,” and this time around it’s Toy meets Tech. 

With Woody helping abandoned toys find owners, Jessie is now the leader of Bonnie's room, with Buzz Lightyear as her second-in-command. But the gang’s jobs get exponentially harder when they go head to head with this all-new threat to playtime…a frog-like tablet named Lilypad.
tmdb_overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

synopsis:
Live-action adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film 'Moana'.

An adventurous teenager sails out on a daring mission to save her people. During her journey, Moana meets the once-mighty demigod Maui, who guides her in her quest to become a master way-finder. Together they sail across the open ocean on an action-packed voyage, encountering enormous monsters and impossible odds. Along the way, Moana fulfills the ancient quest of her ancestors and discovers the one thing she always sought: her own identity.
tmdb_overview: Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with the infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

synopsis:
Dom Cobb is a skilled thief, the absolute best in the dangerous art of extraction, stealing valuable secrets from deep within the subconscious during the dream state when the mind is at its most vulnerable. Cobb's rare ability has made him a coveted player in this treacherous new world of corporate espionage, but it has also made him an international fugitive and cost him everything he has ever loved. Now, Cobb is being offered a chance at redemption. One last job could give him his life back, but only if he can accomplish the impossible -- inception.

Screening on Sundays and Wednesdays as part of our Nolan Throwback Season, where we revisit classics. Each ticket to these showtimes includes complimentary popcorn and a drink.
tmdb_overview: Cobb, a skilled thief who commits corporate espionage by infiltrating the subconscious of his targets is offered a chance to regain his old life as payment for a task considered to be impossible: "inception", the implantation of another person's idea into a target's subconscious.

synopsis:
Following the death of District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman assumes responsibility for Dent's crimes to protect the politcian's reputation but is subsequently hunted by the Gotham City Police Department. 

Eight years after the events of The Dark Knight, Batman returns to Gotham, where he encounters the mysterious Selina Kyle and the villainous Bane, and must confront the latter's plans to destroy the city. But the city he strives to protect has branded him an enemy.

Screening in 35mm as part of Nolan Season at Everyman Screen on the Green.

Dom Cobb is a skilled thief, the absolute best in the dangerous art of extraction, stealing valuable secrets from deep within the subconscious during the dream state when the mind is at its most vulnerable. Cobb's rare ability has made him a coveted player in this treacherous new world of corporate espionage, but it has also made him an international fugitive and cost him everything he has ever loved. Now, Cobb is being offered a chance at redemption. One last job could give him his life back, but only if he can accomplish the impossible -- inception.

Screening on Sundays and Wednesdays as part of our Nolan Throwback Season, where we revisit classics. Each ticket to these showtimes includes complimentary popcorn and a drink.

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

synopsis:

While their fighting parents (Clare Dunne & Michael Socha) tear their hair out with worry, runaways Finn (Roman Griffin Davis) and his live-wire younger brother Charlie (Dexter Sol Ansell) embark on an epic adventure from Yorkshire, over land and sea, to the Wild West coast of Ireland. With the free-spirited busker Cate (Maisie Williams) helping the young boys along the way, their destination is Dingle, County Kerry, and their estranged, beloved Grandfather (BAFTA-award winner Bill Nighy), who their parents haven’t spoken to since the fateful events of the previous summer.

synopsis:
Join us at select Everyman venues from 13 July to 16 July for a special screening of Jockeys of Jamaica, followed by a Live Q&A with Alhan Gençay, to find out what really goes down at Jamaica’s oldest racecourse.

Join Alhan as he visits Belvedere Race Track in Westmoreland, uncovering Jamaica’s rich history of horse racing.

He meets the local jockeys, trainers and the betters who, more than 100 years on, continue to keep the race track alive. Horse racing draws a huge crowd, and with it comes passion, pride and fierce rivalry.

Jockeys of Jamaica is a warm, funny and unexpected look at a community built around one of the island’s oldest sporting traditions.
 
This marks Alhan’s first major independent documentary, and he is bringing it to the big screen for an exclusive cinema preview before it goes online.

Each screening will also include a live introduction and Q&A with Alhan, plus a first look at teasers from his upcoming documentary projects.

DATES:
Everyman Manchester - Monday 13 July
Everyman Birmingham - Tuesday 14 July
Everyman Bristol - Wednesday 15 July
Everyman at The Whiteley - Thursday 16 July

synopsis:
BAFTA Award-winner Lesley Manville (Phantom Thread) joins Aidan Turner (Rivals) in a striking new staging of Christopher Hampton’s celebrated adaptation of the classic novel, where among the glittering salons of the super-rich, one misstep can mean ruin.

Marquise de Merteuil is a master in the art of survival. Alongside the magnetic Vicomte de Valmont, they turn seduction into strategy and weaponise desire.  But when their alliance collapses into rivalry, the battle between them threatens to destroy everyone in their path.

Filmed live on stage at the National Theatre, Marianne Elliott (Angels in America) directs this thrilling game of love, lies, and social warfare.

Now, the cagey Cady has been released, and he intends to teach Sam Bowden and his family a thing or two about loss.

tmdb_overview: This special presentation of Nosferatu: A Symphony of Horror (1922) pairs the original silent film with Radiohead’s “KID A (2000) / Amnesiac (2001) as its score, courtesy of Silents Synced. Silents Synced pairs classic silent movies with epic rock music, partnering with independent cinemas to create memorable, new silent film experiences. "Nosferatu x Radiohead: A Silents Synced Film" is directed and remixed by Josh Frank.

Filmed live onstage at the Harold Pinter Theatre in London's West End in 2025.

tmdb_title: Royal Opera House: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
tmdb_original_title: Royal Opera House: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
tmdb_overview: A full-length ballet created by choreographer Christopher Wheeldon for the Royal Ballet at the Royal Opera House, Covent Garden. The ballet is based on Lewis Carroll's famous story of Alice, an ordinary girl who one summer afternoon falls down a rabbit hole and finds herself on an extraordinary adventure.  The music is by Joby Talbot, with designs by the internationally acclaimed Bob Crowley. Alice is danced by the Royal Ballet's Lauren Cuthbertson, and actor Simon Russell-Beale plays the cameo role of the Duchess.

The music is by Joby Talbot, with designs by the internationally acclaimed Bob Crowley. Alice is danced by the Royal Ballet's Lauren Cuthbertson, and actor Simon Russell-Beale plays the cameo role of the Duchess.

tmdb_overview: A talented piano tuner's life is turned upside down when he discovers that his meticulous skills for tuning pianos can equally be applied to cracking safes.

Fun and contemporary in tone, this refreshing film showcases a star-studded ensemble of humorous performances.

synopsis: Set on Vancouver Island in the late 1990s, Blue Heron follows eight‑year‑old Sasha and her Hungarian immigrant family as they attempt to build a new life, only to be destabilised by the increasingly dangerous behaviour of her older brother, Jeremy. Drawing on her own memories, filmmaker Sophy Romvari shapes a deeply personal portrait of childhood, family fractures, and the fragility of recollection.
tmdb_overview: In the late 1990s, a family of six settles into their new home on Vancouver Island, as internal dynamics are slowly revealed through the experiences of the youngest child, Sasha. Their fresh start is interrupted by the increasingly dangerous behavior of Jeremy, the family's oldest child.

synopsis: The truth about Tesla speaks volumes about CEO Elon Musk, as close confidants, whistleblowers, victims and former high-ranking employees speak out for the first time, pulling back the curtain on Musk's empire. Their testimonies expose hidden data and buried defects in the race for self-driving cars, revealing a culture where tragic losses are treated as acceptable collateral in the pursuit of unchecked ambition. Unfinished products are released, and the public space is used as a deadly testing g
tmdb_title: Elon Musk Unveiled: The Tesla Experiment
tmdb_overview: It's 2014 and tech billionaire Elon Musk unveils his plans for a self-driving car in front of an enthusiastic audience. What consumers don't know is that Tesla's "autopilot" function is far from road-ready, and new owners are being used to improve the software by providing their data. A fatal accident in Florida triggers a protracted lawsuit to hold Tesla accountable. And it's not the only incident. Shocking footage from dashcams and security cameras shows the ruthlessness of Tesla cars suddenly braking or accelerating—and the crashes that follow. Then, an employee leaks thousands of documents containing complaints from users.

synopsis: To mark the centenary of Academy Award-winning director John Schlesinger's birth, we're inviting you to experience his greatest films on the big screen. Season curated by Claire Nicolas and Marc David Jacobs. A KIND OF LOVING The director's first studio movie is a social-realist exploration of a challenged relationship. A flirtation with a typist leads to a pregnancy and a shotgun wedding. It isn't long before the groom (Alan Bates) tires of his overbearing mother-in-law.

Shoot the People is an intimate and urgent portrait of the Oscar-nominated documentarian Misan Harriman. Renowned for his wide-ragning work including powerful breatkthrough images from the 2020 Black Lives Matter protests and capturing the Palestinian liberation movement on film, Harriman also made history as the first Black man to photograph a British Vogue cover.
tmdb_overview: A documentary capturing photographer and activist Misan Harriman’s journey documenting global protest movements that drive social change. Follow Harriman as he highlights the resilience of grassroots activists fighting for equality, civil rights, and social justice, the film showcases the intersectionality of these movements and their collective power. With historical context, interviews with activists, and explorations of digital activism, the documentary reveals how Harriman's lens brings the world's activism to light, inspiring viewers to recognize their own power in shaping a more just society.

BIRDS OF WAR is the love story of a London-based Lebanese journalist and a Syrian activist/cameraman over thirteen years of revolutions, war and exile. Young BBC reporter Janay first contacts Syrian cameraman Habak for footage during the final months of the four-year battle for Aleppo in 2016, one of the bloodiest and most decisive turning points in Syria’s brutal civil war. Over time, through texts, video exchanges, voice messages and shared moments from afar, the bond between them strengthens,
tmdb_overview: The love story of a London-based Lebanese journalist and a Syrian activist and cameraman as told through 13 years of personal archives across revolutions, war, and exile.

Fun and contemporary in tone, this refreshing film showcases a star-studded ensemble of humorous performances.

What consumers don't know is that Tesla's "autopilot" function is far from road-ready, and new owners are being used to improve the software by providing their data. A fatal accident in Florida triggers a protracted lawsuit to hold Tesla accountable. And it's not the only incident. Shocking footage from dashcams and security cameras shows the ruthlessness of Tesla cars suddenly braking or accelerating—and the crashes that follow. Then, an employee leaks thousands of documents containing complaints from users.

Shoot the People is an intimate and urgent portrait of the Oscar-nominated documentarian Misan Harriman. Renowned for his wide-ragning work including powerful breatkthrough images from the 2020 Black Lives Matter protests and capturing the Palestinian liberation movement on film, Harriman also made history as the first Black man to photograph a British Vogue cover.
tmdb_overview: A documentary capturing photographer and activist Misan Harriman’s journey documenting global protest movements that drive social change. Follow Harriman as he highlights the resilience of grassroots activists fighting for equality, civil rights, and social justice, the film showcases the intersectionality of these movements and their collective power. With historical context, interviews with activists, and explorations of digital activism, the documentary reveals how Harriman's lens brings the world's activism to light, inspiring viewers to recognize their own power in shaping a more just society.

BIRDS OF WAR is the love story of a London-based Lebanese journalist and a Syrian activist/cameraman over thirteen years of revolutions, war and exile. Young BBC reporter Janay first contacts Syrian cameraman Habak for footage during the final months of the four-year battle for Aleppo in 2016, one of the bloodiest and most decisive turning points in Syria’s brutal civil war. Over time, through texts, video exchanges, voice messages and shared moments from afar, the bond between them strengthens,
tmdb_overview: The love story of a London-based Lebanese journalist and a Syrian activist and cameraman as told through 13 years of personal archives across revolutions, war, and exile.

Unfinished products are released, and the public space is used as a deadly testing g
tmdb_title: Elon Musk Unveiled: The Tesla Experiment
tmdb_overview: It's 2014 and tech billionaire Elon Musk unveils his plans for a self-driving car in front of an enthusiastic audience. What consumers don't know is that Tesla's "autopilot" function is far from road-ready, and new owners are being used to improve the software by providing their data. A fatal accident in Florida triggers a protracted lawsuit to hold Tesla accountable. And it's not the only incident. Shocking footage from dashcams and security cameras shows the ruthlessness of Tesla cars suddenly braking or accelerating—and the crashes that follow. Then, an employee leaks thousands of documents containing complaints from users.

synopsis: To mark the centenary of Academy Award-winning director John Schlesinger's birth, we're inviting you to experience his greatest films on the big screen. Season curated by Claire Nicolas and Marc David Jacobs. A KIND OF LOVING The director's first studio movie is a social-realist exploration of a challenged relationship. Shoot the People is an intimate and urgent portrait of the Oscar-nominated documentarian Misan Harriman. Renowned for his wide-ragning work including powerful breatkthrough images from the 2020 Black Lives Matter protests and capturing the Palestinian liberation movement on film, Harriman also made history as the first Black man to photograph a British Vogue cover.
tmdb_overview: A documentary capturing photographer and activist Misan Harriman’s journey documenting global protest movements that drive social change. Follow Harriman as he highlights the resilience of grassroots activists fighting for equality, civil rights, and social justice, the film showcases the intersectionality of these movements and their collective power. With historical context, interviews with activists, and explorations of digital activism, the documentary reveals how Harriman's lens brings the world's activism to light, inspiring viewers to recognize their own power in shaping a more just society.

BIRDS OF WAR is the love story of a London-based Lebanese journalist and a Syrian activist/cameraman over thirteen years of revolutions, war and exile. Young BBC reporter Janay first contacts Syrian cameraman Habak for footage during the final months of the four-year battle for Aleppo in 2016, one of the bloodiest and most decisive turning points in Syria’s brutal civil war. Over time, through texts, video exchanges, voice messages and shared moments from afar, the bond between them strengthens,

synopsis: The truth about Tesla speaks volumes about CEO Elon Musk, as close confidants, whistleblowers, victims and former high-ranking employees speak out for the first time, pulling back the curtain on Musk's empire. Their testimonies expose hidden data and buried defects in the race for self-driving cars, revealing a culture where tragic losses are treated as acceptable collateral in the pursuit of unchecked ambition. Unfinished products are released, and the public space is used as a deadly testing g
tmdb_title: Elon Musk Unveiled: The Tesla Experiment
tmdb_overview: It's 2014 and tech billionaire Elon Musk unveils his plans for a self-driving car in front of an enthusiastic audience. What consumers don't know is that Tesla's "autopilot" function is far from road-ready, and new owners are being used to improve the software by providing their data. A fatal accident in Florida triggers a protracted lawsuit to hold Tesla accountable. And it's not the only incident. Shocking footage from dashcams and security cameras shows the ruthlessness of Tesla cars suddenly braking or accelerating—and the crashes that follow. Then, an employee leaks thousands of documents containing complaints from users.

synopsis: To mark the centenary of Academy Award-winning director John Schlesinger's birth, we're inviting you to experience his greatest films on the big screen. Season curated by Claire Nicolas and Marc David Jacobs. A KIND OF LOVING The director's first studio movie is a social-realist exploration of a challenged relationship. A flirtation with a typist leads to a pregnancy and a shotgun wedding. It isn't long before the groom (Alan Bates) tires of his overbearing mother-in-law.

Shoot the People is an intimate and urgent portrait of the Oscar-nominated documentarian Misan Harriman. Renowned for his wide-ragning work including powerful breatkthrough images from the 2020 Black Lives Matter protests and capturing the Palestinian liberation movement on film, Harriman also made history as the first Black man to photograph a British Vogue cover.
tmdb_overview: A documentary capturing photographer and activist Misan Harriman’s journey documenting global protest movements that drive social change. Follow Harriman as he highlights the resilience of grassroots activists fighting for equality, civil rights, and social justice, the film showcases the intersectionality of these movements and their collective power. With historical context, interviews with activists, and explorations of digital activism, the documentary reveals how Harriman's lens brings the world's activism to light, inspiring viewers to recognize their own power in shaping a more just society.

BIRDS OF WAR is the love story of a London-based Lebanese journalist and a Syrian activist/cameraman over thirteen years of revolutions, war and exile. Young BBC reporter Janay first contacts Syrian cameraman Habak for footage during the final months of the four-year battle for Aleppo in 2016, one of the bloodiest and most decisive turning points in Syria’s brutal civil war. Over time, through texts, video exchanges, voice messages and shared moments from afar, the bond between them strengthens,
tmdb_overview: The love story of a London-based Lebanese journalist and a Syrian activist and cameraman as told through 13 years of personal archives across revolutions, war, and exile.

synopsis: The truth about Tesla speaks volumes about CEO Elon Musk, as close confidants, whistleblowers, victims and former high-ranking employees speak out for the first time, pulling back the curtain on Musk's empire. Their testimonies expose hidden data and buried defects in the race for self-driving cars, revealing a culture where tragic losses are treated as acceptable collateral in the pursuit of unchecked ambition. Unfinished products are released, and the public space is used as a deadly testing g
tmdb_title: Elon Musk Unveiled: The Tesla Experiment
tmdb_overview: It's 2014 and tech billionaire Elon Musk unveils his plans for a self-driving car in front of an enthusiastic audience. What consumers don't know is that Tesla's "autopilot" function is far from road-ready, and new owners are being used to improve the software by providing their data. A fatal accident in Florida triggers a protracted lawsuit to hold Tesla accountable. And it's not the only incident. Shocking footage from dashcams and security cameras shows the ruthlessness of Tesla cars suddenly braking or accelerating—and the crashes that follow. Then, an employee leaks thousands of documents containing complaints from users.

movie_title: FILM CLUB: A KIND OF LOVING

synopsis: To mark the centenary of Academy Award-winning director John Schlesinger's birth, we're inviting you to experience his greatest films on the big screen. Season curated by Claire Nicolas and Marc David Jacobs. A KIND OF LOVING The director's first studio movie is a social-realist exploration of a challenged relationship. A flirtation with a typist leads to a pregnancy and a shotgun wedding. It isn't long before the groom (Alan Bates) tires of his overbearing mother-in-law.

Shoot the People is an intimate and urgent portrait of the Oscar-nominated documentarian Misan Harriman. Renowned for his wide-ragning work including powerful breatkthrough images from the 2020 Black Lives Matter protests and capturing the Palestinian liberation movement on film, Harriman also made history as the first Black man to photograph a British Vogue cover.
tmdb_overview: A documentary capturing photographer and activist Misan Harriman’s journey documenting global protest movements that drive social change. Follow Harriman as he highlights the resilience of grassroots activists fighting for equality, civil rights, and social justice, the film showcases the intersectionality of these movements and their collective power. With historical context, interviews with activists, and explorations of digital activism, the documentary reveals how Harriman's lens brings the world's activism to light, inspiring viewers to recognize their own power in shaping a more just society.

BIRDS OF WAR is the love story of a London-based Lebanese journalist and a Syrian activist/cameraman over thirteen years of revolutions, war and exile. Young BBC reporter Janay first contacts Syrian cameraman Habak for footage during the final months of the four-year battle for Aleppo in 2016, one of the bloodiest and most decisive turning points in Syria’s brutal civil war. Over time, through texts, video exchanges, voice messages and shared moments from afar, the bond between them strengthens,
tmdb_overview: The love story of a London-based Lebanese journalist and a Syrian activist and cameraman as told through 13 years of personal archives across revolutions, war, and exile.

Unfinished products are released, and the public space is used as a deadly testing g
tmdb_title: Elon Musk Unveiled: The Tesla Experiment
tmdb_overview: It's 2014 and tech billionaire Elon Musk unveils his plans for a self-driving car in front of an enthusiastic audience. What consumers don't know is that Tesla's "autopilot" function is far from road-ready, and new owners are being used to improve the software by providing their data. A fatal accident in Florida triggers a protracted lawsuit to hold Tesla accountable. And it's not the only incident. Shocking footage from dashcams and security cameras shows the ruthlessness of Tesla cars suddenly braking or accelerating—and the crashes that follow. Then, an employee leaks thousands of documents containing complaints from users.

Shoot the People is an intimate and urgent portrait of the Oscar-nominated documentarian Misan Harriman. Renowned for his wide-ragning work including powerful breatkthrough images from the 2020 Black Lives Matter protests and capturing the Palestinian liberation movement on film, Harriman also made history as the first Black man to photograph a British Vogue cover.
tmdb_overview: A documentary capturing photographer and activist Misan Harriman’s journey documenting global protest movements that drive social change. Follow Harriman as he highlights the resilience of grassroots activists fighting for equality, civil rights, and social justice, the film showcases the intersectionality of these movements and their collective power. With historical context, interviews with activists, and explorations of digital activism, the documentary reveals how Harriman's lens brings the world's activism to light, inspiring viewers to recognize their own power in shaping a more just society.

tmdb_overview: The love story of a London-based Lebanese journalist and a Syrian activist and cameraman as told through 13 years of personal archives across revolutions, war, and exile.

tmdb_title: Elon Musk Unveiled: The Tesla Experiment
tmdb_overview: It's 2014 and tech billionaire Elon Musk unveils his plans for a self-driving car in front of an enthusiastic audience. What consumers don't know is that Tesla's "autopilot" function is far from road-ready, and new owners are being used to improve the software by providing their data. A fatal accident in Florida triggers a protracted lawsuit to hold Tesla accountable. And it's not the only incident. Shocking footage from dashcams and security cameras shows the ruthlessness of Tesla cars suddenly braking or accelerating—and the crashes that follow. Then, an employee leaks thousands of documents containing complaints from users.

synopsis: To mark the centenary of Academy Award-winning director John Schlesinger's birth, we're inviting you to experience his greatest films on the big screen. Season curated by Claire Nicolas and Marc David Jacobs. A KIND OF LOVING The director's first studio movie is a social-realist exploration of a challenged relationship. A flirtation with a typist leads to a pregnancy and a shotgun wedding. It isn't long before the groom (Alan Bates) tires of his overbearing mother-in-law.

synopsis: In the basement of a furniture showroom, a man (Chiwetel Ejiofor) stumbles upon a strange doorway that leads into a mysterious, otherworldly labyrinth. His therapist (Renate Reinsve) doesn't believe him, so he sets out on a mission to gather some proof.

Shoot the People is an intimate and urgent portrait of the Oscar-nominated documentarian Misan Harriman. Renowned for his wide-ragning work including powerful breatkthrough images from the 2020 Black Lives Matter protests and capturing the Palestinian liberation movement on film, Harriman also made history as the first Black man to photograph a British Vogue cover.
tmdb_overview: A documentary capturing photographer and activist Misan Harriman’s journey documenting global protest movements that drive social change. Follow Harriman as he highlights the resilience of grassroots activists fighting for equality, civil rights, and social justice, the film showcases the intersectionality of these movements and their collective power. With historical context, interviews with activists, and explorations of digital activism, the documentary reveals how Harriman's lens brings the world's activism to light, inspiring viewers to recognize their own power in shaping a more just society.

synopsis: Twenty years after making their iconic turns as Miranda, Andy, Emily and Nigel—Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt and Stanley Tucci return to the fashionable streets of New York City and the sleek offices of Runway Magazine in 20th Century Studios’ “The Devil Wears Prada 2,” the eagerly awaited sequel to the 2006 phenomenon that defined a generation. tmdb_overview: Andy Sachs returns to Runway as Miranda Priestly navigates a new media landscape and Runway's position within. The duo reconnect with former assistant Emily Charlton, now the head of a luxury brand that possesses funding which could ensure Runway's survival.

BIRDS OF WAR is the love story of a London-based Lebanese journalist and a Syrian activist/cameraman over thirteen years of revolutions, war and exile. Young BBC reporter Janay first contacts Syrian cameraman Habak for footage during the final months of the four-year battle for Aleppo in 2016, one of the bloodiest and most decisive turning points in Syria’s brutal civil war. Over time, through texts, video exchanges, voice messages and shared moments from afar, the bond between them strengthens,
tmdb_overview: The love story of a London-based Lebanese journalist and a Syrian activist and cameraman as told through 13 years of personal archives across revolutions, war, and exile.

synopsis: Based on Virginia Woolf’s funniest novel, Night & Day is an un-romantic comedy about the passionate astronomer, Katharine Hilbery who does everything she can to avoid romantic love and marriage. Her bold challenge to Edwardian patriarchy is set against the suffragette movement and advances in science and technology. Fun and contemporary in tone, this refreshing film showcases a star-studded ensemble of humorous performances.

tmdb_overview: It's 2014 and tech billionaire Elon Musk unveils his plans for a self-driving car in front of an enthusiastic audience. What consumers don't know is that Tesla's "autopilot" function is far from road-ready, and new owners are being used to improve the software by providing their data. A fatal accident in Florida triggers a protracted lawsuit to hold Tesla accountable. And it's not the only incident. Shocking footage from dashcams and security cameras shows the ruthlessness of Tesla cars suddenly braking or accelerating—and the crashes that follow. Then, an employee leaks thousands of documents containing complaints from users.

Shoot the People is an intimate and urgent portrait of the Oscar-nominated documentarian Misan Harriman. Renowned for his wide-ragning work including powerful breatkthrough images from the 2020 Black Lives Matter protests and capturing the Palestinian liberation movement on film, Harriman also made history as the first Black man to photograph a British Vogue cover.
tmdb_overview: A documentary capturing photographer and activist Misan Harriman’s journey documenting global protest movements that drive social change. Follow Harriman as he highlights the resilience of grassroots activists fighting for equality, civil rights, and social justice, the film showcases the intersectionality of these movements and their collective power. With historical context, interviews with activists, and explorations of digital activism, the documentary reveals how Harriman's lens brings the world's activism to light, inspiring viewers to recognize their own power in shaping a more just society.

BIRDS OF WAR is the love story of a London-based Lebanese journalist and a Syrian activist/cameraman over thirteen years of revolutions, war and exile. Young BBC reporter Janay first contacts Syrian cameraman Habak for footage during the final months of the four-year battle for Aleppo in 2016, one of the bloodiest and most decisive turning points in Syria’s brutal civil war. Over time, through texts, video exchanges, voice messages and shared moments from afar, the bond between them strengthens,
tmdb_overview: The love story of a London-based Lebanese journalist and a Syrian activist and cameraman as told through 13 years of personal archives across revolutions, war, and exile.

synopsis: After serving fifteen years in prison, bank robber Anker (Nikolaj Lie Kaas) is determined to recover the stolen money his brother Manfred (Mads Mikkelsen) buried years earlier. There’s just one problem: Manfred, caught in an identity crisis and convinced he is John Lennon, can no longer remember where it is hidden. The brothers set off on an increasingly chaotic hunt for the missing fortune, digging up old family secrets on the way.

movie_title_en: DOCHOUSE: ELON MUSK UNVEILED -THE TESLA EXPERIMENT
synopsis: The truth about Tesla speaks volumes about CEO Elon Musk, as close confidants, whistleblowers, victims and former high-ranking employees speak out for the first time, pulling back the curtain on Musk's empire. Their testimonies expose hidden data and buried defects in the race for self-driving cars, revealing a culture where tragic losses are treated as acceptable collateral in the pursuit of unchecked ambition. Unfinished products are released, and the public space is used as a deadly testing g
tmdb_title: Elon Musk Unveiled: The Tesla Experiment
tmdb_overview: It's 2014 and tech billionaire Elon Musk unveils his plans for a self-driving car in front of an enthusiastic audience. What consumers don't know is that Tesla's "autopilot" function is far from road-ready, and new owners are being used to improve the software by providing their data. A fatal accident in Florida triggers a protracted lawsuit to hold Tesla accountable. And it's not the only incident. Shocking footage from dashcams and security cameras shows the ruthlessness of Tesla cars suddenly braking or accelerating—and the crashes that follow. Then, an employee leaks thousands of documents containing complaints from users.

Shoot the People is an intimate and urgent portrait of the Oscar-nominated documentarian Misan Harriman. Renowned for his wide-ragning work including powerful breatkthrough images from the 2020 Black Lives Matter protests and capturing the Palestinian liberation movement on film, Harriman also made history as the first Black man to photograph a British Vogue cover.
tmdb_overview: A documentary capturing photographer and activist Misan Harriman’s journey documenting global protest movements that drive social change. Follow Harriman as he highlights the resilience of grassroots activists fighting for equality, civil rights, and social justice, the film showcases the intersectionality of these movements and their collective power. With historical context, interviews with activists, and explorations of digital activism, the documentary reveals how Harriman's lens brings the world's activism to light, inspiring viewers to recognize their own power in shaping a more just society.

BIRDS OF WAR is the love story of a London-based Lebanese journalist and a Syrian activist/cameraman over thirteen years of revolutions, war and exile. Young BBC reporter Janay first contacts Syrian cameraman Habak for footage during the final months of the four-year battle for Aleppo in 2016, one of the bloodiest and most decisive turning points in Syria’s brutal civil war. Over time, through texts, video exchanges, voice messages and shared moments from afar, the bond between them strengthens,
tmdb_overview: The love story of a London-based Lebanese journalist and a Syrian activist and cameraman as told through 13 years of personal archives across revolutions, war, and exile.
